theorems.name: Submission.tdo_ods_interval_sup_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (W : ℝ → Rn ℓ) (a : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 < a → LipschitzOnWith K W (Icc (-a) a) → ∀ t ∈ Icc (-a) a, ‖W t‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * a)⁻¹ * ∫ s in Ioo (-a) a, ‖W s‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (2 * a * ∫ s in Ioo (-a) a, ‖deriv W s‖ ^ 2)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
